# KAF Eatables

> Lagos food business making small chops, peppered and grilled chicken, puff puff, sandwiches and party packs fresh to order, with event catering across Nigeria. Orders are placed by WhatsApp; there is no online checkout.

Tagline: Good food, good mood.
CEO/MD: Miss Kofoworola Laguda.
Location: Lagos, Nigeria (delivery across Lagos; travels for catering events).
Contact: WhatsApp +234 905 355 1681; phone 0905 355 1681 or 0812 526 1879.

## Pages

- [Home](/): overview, customer favourites, how ordering works, catering and kitchen highlights.
- [Menu](/menu): full menu with prices in naira across Small Chops, Grills & Chicken, Party Packs, and Sandwiches & Wraps.
- [Catering](/catering): event catering formats (sharing trays, per-guest party packs, branded packs), what is included, and how to book.
- [About](/about): the story, standards and behind-the-scenes photos and video from the kitchen.
- [Contact](/contact): WhatsApp, phone numbers and Instagram.

## Menu summary

- Small chops: platters and trays, spring rolls, samosa, puff puff, stick meat.
- Grills and chicken: peppered fried chicken, grilled chicken, chicken kebab skewers, chicken and chips, chicken and plantain, chicken and gizzard baskets.
- Party packs: per-guest boats, chicken and fries packs, puff puff and chicken baskets.
- Sandwiches and wraps: club sandwich, chicken burger, chicken and beef shawarma.

## Ordering

1. Add items to the order on the website.
2. Send the pre-filled order message on WhatsApp.
3. KAF confirms availability, delivery fee and payment in chat.

## Machine-readable

- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
- Structured data: schema.org FoodEstablishment (LocalBusiness), Menu, BreadcrumbList and WebPage JSON-LD on each page.
